title: Angle-Resolved Reflectance Measurements in the Vacuum Ultraviolet for Metallic Samples
abstract: The light yield of noble-element scintillation detectors depends strongly on the reflective properties of detector materials in the vacuum ultraviolet (VUV), where optical measurements are scarce. For this reason, we built a custom rotary setup at IFIC, equipped with a monochromator and operated in a gaseous argon atmosphere, to perform angle-resolved reflectance measurements in the specular reflection plane. We describe the setup and its extensive characterization, together with the procedure used to measure the bidirectional reflectance distribution function (BRDF) of materials at various angles of incidence, for wavelengths from 128 to 500 nm, covering both the argon (128 nm) and xenon (175 nm) scintillation wavelengths. To illustrate the capabilities of the setup, we present results for rough aluminum and stainless-steel surfaces as reference materials. Fitting the measured angular profiles with the analytical GGX microfacet model allows us to extract the real and imaginary parts of the refractive index and the surface roughness parameter of each sample. These parameters are then used to extrapolate the in-plane measurements to the full hemisphere and from gaseous argon to liquid media, enabling the inference of the hemispherical reflectance in gaseous argon, liquid argon and liquid xenon.
subjects: Instrumentation and Detectors (physics.ins-det) ; High Energy Physics - Experiment (hep-ex); Optics (physics.optics)

summaries.en: We built a custom angle-resolved reflectance setup operating in a gaseous argon atmosphere from 128 to 500 nm to measure the bidirectional reflectance distribution function of metallic samples, and by fitting the angular profiles with the GGX microfacet model we extracted the complex refractive index and surface roughness and extrapolated the results to obtain hemispherical reflectance in gaseous argon, liquid argon, and liquid xenon.
summaries.zh: 我们搭建了一套在气态氩气氛中工作、波长覆盖128至500纳米的定制角度分辨反射率测量装置，用于测量金属样品的双向反射分布函数，并通过用GGX微表面模型拟合角分布曲线提取了复折射率与表面粗糙度，进而外推得到气态氩、液氩和液氙中的半球反射率。
summaries.ja: 気体アルゴン雰囲気中で128〜500 nmの波長域で動作する独自の角度分解反射率測定装置を構築して金属試料の双方向反射分布関数を測定し、角度プロファイルをGGXマイクロファセットモデルでフィッティングすることで複素屈折率と表面粗さを抽出し、気体アルゴン・液体アルゴン・液体キセノン中での半球反射率を外挿により求めた。

title: Thin-film lithium niobate integrated photonics at 493 nm
abstract: Visible and near-ultraviolet light underpins applications from biophotonics to quantum computing, which demand fast control of optical amplitude and phase. Integrated photonics offers scalable control, yet most visible-wavelength platforms lack gigahertz-scale modulation. We demonstrate a thin-film lithium niobate platform at 493 nm integrating grating couplers, beamsplitters, ring resonators, and modulators. Segmented traveling-wave modulators achieve a half-wave voltage--length product of 450 mV$\cdot$cm, $>$20 dB extinction, and bandwidth beyond 50 GHz. Ring resonators show $2.9 \pm 0.2$ dB/cm propagation loss and quantify the platform's photorefractive response. This enables agile visible beam delivery for trapped-ion systems, although photorefraction and substrate uniformity remain key challenges to scaling.

summaries.en: A thin-film lithium niobate integrated photonics platform operating at 493 nm integrates grating couplers, beamsplitters, ring resonators, and segmented traveling-wave modulators achieving a 450 mV·cm half-wave voltage-length product, >20 dB extinction, and >50 GHz bandwidth, enabling agile visible beam delivery for trapped-ion systems despite remaining challenges in photorefraction and substrate uniformity.
summaries.zh: 本文展示了一个工作在493 nm波长的薄膜铌酸锂集成光子平台，集成了光栅耦合器、分束器、环形谐振腔和调制器，其分段行波调制器实现了450 mV·cm的半波电压-长度积、超过20 dB的消光比以及超过50 GHz的带宽，可实现面向离子阱系统的灵活可见光光束传输，但光折变效应和衬底均匀性仍是规模化应用的主要挑战。
summaries.ja: 493 nmで動作する薄膜ニオブ酸リチウム集積フォトニクス基板がグレーティングカプラ、ビームスプリッタ、リング共振器、変調器を集積し、セグメント化進行波変調器により450 mV·cmの半波電圧-長積、20 dB超の消光比、50 GHz超の帯域を達成しており、光屈折効果と基板均一性がスケーリング上の課題として残るものの、イオントラップ系向けの機動的な可視光ビーム供給を可能にする。

title: Exceptional points in non-Markovian quantum-state diffusion: From coefficient dynamics to state signatures
abstract: An exceptional point of a memory-coefficient equation need not have the same signature in every quantum-state observable. We examine this relation within exact non-Markovian quantum-state diffusion (NMQSD), following the same operator closure from its coefficient dynamics to the non-Markovian master equation obtained by noise averaging. A finite homogeneous lift identifies the Jordan chains reached by the causal initialization, while state reconstruction determines which contributions survive in a specified readout. Two models expose the distinction. For common-bath qubits restricted to zero and one excitation, a noise-independent lowering-form $O$ operator gives a closed master equation. Every defective decaying mode transfers its full pole order to a suitable unconditional excitation--reference coherence. A known third-order configuration illustrates both a quadratic--exponential coherence and cancellation of its highest-order term in another quadrature. For a position-coupled oscillator in a fixed-photon-number optomechanical sector, the exact closure contains a scalar noise-history term. On the regular normalizable branch studied for bath decay rates below the oscillator frequency, two second-order coefficient blocks lead to a double pole in the conditional displacement response to the NMQSD noise history, at long preparation age and fixed lag. The purely algebraic coefficient tail cancels from the conditional Gaussian width. Complete noise averaging changes the master-equation coefficients and combines conditional width with the weighted spread of state centers. Together, the models show how causal preparation, state reconstruction, and averaging give coefficient exceptional points a precise, readout-dependent meaning.

summaries.en: The paper shows that exceptional points in non-Markovian quantum-state diffusion coefficient dynamics map onto quantum-state observables only through causal initialization, state reconstruction, and noise averaging, making their signatures readout-dependent, as illustrated by a common-bath qubit model with full pole-order transfer to coherences and a position-coupled oscillator model with a double pole in the conditional displacement response but cancellation in the conditional Gaussian width.
summaries.zh: 本文表明，非马尔可夫量子态扩散中的系数动力学例外点只有通过因果初始化、态重构和噪声平均才能映射到量子态可观测量上，因此其签名依赖于具体的读出方式，并以共同浴量子比特模型中极点阶数向相干性的完整转移以及位置耦合振子模型中条件位移响应的双极点与条件高斯宽度中的抵消为例加以说明。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、非マルコフ量子状態拡散の係数ダイナミクスにおける例外点が、因果的初期化・状態再構成・ノイズ平均を通じてのみ量子状態の観測量に反映され、そのsignatureが読み出しに依存することを示し、共通浴量子ビット模型でのコヒーレンスへの極次数の完全な移行と、位置結合振動子模型での条件付き変位応答における二重極および条件付きガウス幅での相殺によって例証している。

title: Real-time spectral combs from delayed quantum feedback in multimode cavity QED
abstract: We study the time-dependent physical spectrum of light for a two-level atom coupled to a large, but discrete, number of modes of an electromagnetic cavity. Radiation emitted by the atom, placed at the center of the cavity, returns after the round-trip time $t_r$, re-excites it, and is re-emitted, producing a sequence of atomic population revivals. For a coupling approximately flat over the atomic linewidth, the emission dynamics reduces to a delay-differential equation of Bixon--Jortner type. Using its analytical solution in terms of Laguerre polynomials, we investigate how successive emission and reabsorption cycles shape the time-dependent spectrum. The physical spectrum exhibits revivals during which a transient frequency comb of spacing $2\pi/t_r$ develops. The comb results from the quantum interference between successive emission stages; its teeth sit not at the cavity modes but at the resonances of the effective two half-cavities created by the resonantly reflecting atom. The visibility scales as $e^{-\Gamma t_r}$ with the filter bandwidth $\Gamma$, and at long times the comb converges to the dressed-mode spectrum, which we also obtain analytically in quantitative agreement with exact diagonalization. We show that the physical spectrum resolves the feedback phase, to which the atomic population is insensitive in the regime of well-separated emission stages, and provides additional frequency-resolved signatures of the atomic position. We discuss two feasible experimental implementations of our results with transmons (artificial atoms) coupled to microwave and surface-acoustic-wave resonators.

summaries.en: A two-level atom coupled to a large discrete set of cavity modes reabsorbs its own delayed emission, producing population revivals and a transient frequency comb of spacing 2π/t_r in the time-dependent physical spectrum, whose comb teeth sit at the resonances of the effective half-cavities formed by the reflecting atom and whose visibility decays as e^{-Γt_r} with filter bandwidth Γ.
summaries.zh: 一个与大数目离散腔模耦合的二能级原子会重新吸收自身延迟发射的光，产生原子布居复苏以及时间依赖物理谱中间距为2π/t_r的瞬态频率梳，其梳齿位于反射原子所形成的有效半腔共振处，可见度按e^{-Γt_r}随滤波带宽Γ衰减。
summaries.ja: 多数の離散的なキャビティモードと結合した二準位原子は自身の遅延放出光を再吸収して原子的占有数の復活を生じ、時間依存物理スペクトルには間隔2π/t_rの過渡的な周波数コムが現れ、その歯は反射する原子が作る実効的半キャビティの共鳴に位置し、可視度はフィルタ帯域幅Γに対しe^{-Γt_r}で減衰する。

title: Observation of strong electric dipole-dipole interactions between two atoms
abstract: We have prepared pairs of atoms at densities exceeding $ 10^{16}/\rm{cm}^3$ corresponding to $n\lambdabar^3>10$ and studied how they interact with light. In this regime, the coherent part of the electric dipole-dipole interaction is larger than the dissipative part, and a single photon emission can transfer large momenta (larger than ten times the single photon recoil) to the atoms. For off-resonant laser light, the atoms are dressed with an electric dipole moment of $\approx$ 1 Debye and interact coherently. This light-induced dipole-dipole interaction has been previously observed only in the far-field mean-field regime. For two atoms, the resonance is shifted by the two-body Lamb shift which is dominated by the near-field part of the dipolar interaction. Dipolar resonance shifts have been observed before only for many atoms interacting with the far-field part of the dipolar interaction. Our work sheds new light on photoassociation processes and paves the way for studying driven quantum systems with strong electric dipole-dipole interactions.

summaries.en: Pairs of atoms at densities above 10^16/cm^3 were studied, revealing that the coherent electric dipole-dipole interaction exceeds the dissipative part, enables single-photon emission to transfer momenta over ten times the recoil, and shifts the two-atom resonance via a near-field-dominated two-body Lamb shift.
summaries.zh: 研究了密度超过10^16/cm^3的原子对，发现相干电偶极-偶极相互作用大于耗散部分，单光子发射可向原子传递超过十倍单光子反冲动量的动量，并且两原子共振因近场主导的两体兰姆位移而发生移动。
summaries.ja: 10^16/cm^3を超える密度の原子対を研究し、コヒーレントな電気双極子-双極子相互作用が散逸部分より大きく、単一光子放出が単一光子反跳の10倍以上の運動量を原子に与え得ること、また二原子共鳴が近接場支配の二体ラムシフトにより移動することを示した。

title: Eigenmode and field imaging of a compact superconducting resonator array
abstract: Superconducting resonator arrays can tailor the photonic environment for quantum information processing, but conventional port-based microwave spectroscopy alone does not resolve the rich spatial structure of their modes. Here, we apply laser scanning microscopy (LSM) and nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center magnetometry to a two-dimensional superconducting resonator array consisting of 33 lumped-element resonators arranged in a honeycomb lattice hosting topological edge states. We demonstrate the complementarity of the two techniques: LSM images the eigenmodes, while NV magnetometry maps the local microwave magnetic field amplitude. Using this spatial information, we experimentally validate that the realized lattice matches the design, we image the topological edge state and measure its sublattice polarization, and place an upper bound of $\approx0.3\%$ on the relative on-site frequency disorder in the lattice. Our work establishes a combined spatial characterization approach for compact superconducting resonator arrays with applications in hybrid spin--superconducting quantum systems.

summaries.en: Laser scanning microscopy and nitrogen-vacancy center magnetometry are combined to image the eigenmodes and local microwave magnetic field of a 33-resonator honeycomb superconducting array, validating the designed lattice, imaging a topological edge state with its sublattice polarization, and bounding relative on-site frequency disorder at about 0.
summaries.zh: 结合激光扫描显微镜与氮空位中心磁测量术，对由33个谐振器构成的蜂窝状超导谐振器阵列进行本征模与局部微波磁场成像，验证了实际晶格与设计一致，成像了拓扑边缘态及其子晶格极化，并将相对在位频率无序度的上界限定在约0.
summaries.ja: レーザー走査顕微鏡と窒素空孔中心磁気測定を組み合わせ、33個の共振器からなるハニカム格子超伝導共振器アレイの固有モードと局所マイクロ波磁場を撮像し、設計通りの格子であることを検証するとともにトポロジカル端状態とその副格子分極を画像化し、相対的なオンサイト周波数無秩序の上限を約0.

title: Analog quantum approximate optimization algorithm for solving the weighted MaxCut problem on three-dimensional single-atom Rydberg array
abstract: We theoretically investigate an analog implementation of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) for the weighted maximum cut problem (MaxCut) problem. The protocol uses a three-dimensional array of individually trapped Rydberg atoms driven by globally addressed laser pulses, with site-dependent detunings applied near the Rydberg resonance. As benchmarks, we consider twenty randomly weighted 3-regular graphs with 12 vertices each. Problem weights are encoded directly in the interatomic interaction energies by choosing appropriate three-dimensional atom positions. We compare two parameter-optimization strategies: discretized quantum annealing and warm-start initialization using a graph neural network (GNN). The combined optimization strategy creates a portfolio that outperforms the Goemans-Williamson (GW) rounding almost in all instances in the noiseless case. We analyze the sampling statistics and the total pulse-time cost of both approaches. Finally, we emulate the performance of the optimized schedules on quantum trajectories using a realistic error model of the Aquila neutral-atom quantum processor.

summaries.en: This paper theoretically studies an analog QAOA for weighted MaxCut using a three-dimensional array of individually trapped Rydberg atoms with globally addressed laser pulses and site-dependent detunings, benchmarking on twenty randomly weighted 3-regular graphs with 12 vertices by encoding weights in interatomic interaction energies via atom positions, comparing discretized quantum annealing and GNN warm-start initialization whose combined portfolio outperforms Goemans-Williamson rounding in almost all noiseless instances, and emulating the optimized schedules on quantum trajectories with a realistic Aquila processor error model.
summaries.zh: 本文理论研究了一种用于加权最大割问题的模拟量子近似优化算法，采用由全局寻址激光脉冲驱动、在里德堡共振附近施加位点相关失谐的三维单原子里德堡阵列，以二十个各含12个顶点的随机加权3-正则图为基准，通过选择合适的原子位置将问题权重编码到原子间相互作用能中，比较了离散化量子退火与基于图神经网络的热启动初始化两种参数优化策略，其组合方案在无噪声情形下几乎在所有实例中优于Goemans-Williamson舍入，并利用Aquila中性原子量子处理器的真实误差模型在量子轨迹上模拟了优化调度方案的性能。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、全体照射レーザーパルスで駆動されリュードベリ共鳴付近でサイト依存の離調を加えた三次元単原子リュードベリ配列を用いた重み付き最大カット問題に対するアナログQAOAを理論的に研究し、各12頂点のランダム重み付き3正則グラフ20個をベンチマークとして原子位置の選択により問題の重みを原子間相互作用エネルギーに符号化し、離散化量子アニーリングとグラフニューラルネットワークによるウォームスタート初期化の2つのパラメータ最適化戦略を比較してその組み合わせが無雑音の場合ほぼ全インスタンスでGoemans-Williamson丸めを上回ることを示すとともに、Aquila中性原子量子プロセッサの現実的誤りモデルを用いた量子軌道上で最適化スケジュールの性能をエミュレートする。

title: Quantum propagation of vibrational excitation in harmonically confined trapped-ion crystal
abstract: Vibrational excitations, or phonons, in trapped ions serve as useful resources for quantum information processing, including quantum simulation and computing. Localized excitations of ions' vibrational motion (local phonons) can be used for simulating quantum particles that propagate over a system. Here, we experimentally investigate the propagation of a localized vibrational excitation in a one-dimensional trapped-ion crystal. A 10-ion crystal confined in a harmonic potential is used. It is found that inhomogeneity in the spacing between the ions leads to characteristic behaviors such as adjacent hopping and global movement. A comparison of the experimental results with numerical simulations shows agreement up to fine details. The system explored here may be extended to many-body systems of bosonic particles as well as more complex quasiparticles.

summaries.en: Experiments on a 10-ion harmonically confined trapped-ion crystal show that a localized vibrational excitation propagates with characteristic behaviors such as adjacent hopping and global movement arising from the inhomogeneous ion spacing, in agreement with numerical simulations up to fine details.
summaries.zh: 在10个离子组成的谐波势阱离子晶体中，实验研究表明，局域振动激发会因离子间距的不均匀性而表现出相邻跃迁和整体移动等特征行为，且实验结果与数值模拟在细节上高度吻合。
summaries.ja: 10個のイオンからなる調和ポテンシャルに関じ込められたイオン結晶の実験により、局所的な振動励起がイオン間隔の不均一性に起因する隣接ホッピングや全体移動といった特徴的な振る舞いを示し、その結果は数値シミュレーションと細部まで一致することが明らかになった。

title: CV-TF-QKD
abstract: We introduce a continuous-variable version of twin-field quantum key distribution, using independent Gaussian-modulated coherent states and an untrusted single-photon relay. Full-record reconciliation and a binary phase-disclosure protocol achieve nearly equal asymptotic key rates against collective attacks. At fixed weak input-referred excess noise per arm, both rates per relay use scale as $\sqrt{\eta}$, where $\eta$ is the end-to-end transmissivity. For phase disclosure, we establish composable security against general coherent attacks using a bounded test of preparation intensities and sign-parity complementarity. For specified apparatus parameters, finite-key calculations incorporating detector inefficiency, dark counts, phase fluctuations, and reference overhead predict rates exceeding the pure-loss and matched thermal-loss repeaterless bounds. These results extend the twin-field advantage to Gaussian-modulated continuous-variable quantum cryptography.

summaries.en: This paper introduces a continuous-variable twin-field quantum key distribution protocol using Gaussian-modulated coherent states and an untrusted single-photon relay that achieves key rates scaling as the square root of the end-to-end transmissivity, with composable security against coherent attacks and predicted finite-key rates exceeding repeaterless bounds.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种连续变量孪生场量子密钥分发协议，采用高斯调制相干态和不可信单光子中继，其密钥率随端到端透射率的平方根缩放，并具备对相干攻击的可组合安全性，有限密钥计算预测的密钥率超过无中继界限。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、ガウス変調コヒーレント状態と信頼できない単一光子リレーを用いた連続変数ツインフィールド量子鍵配送を提案し、鍵生成率が端到端透過率の平方根でスケールし、コヒーレント攻撃に対する構成可能な安全性を備え、有限鍵計算による予測鍵生成率が中継器なしの限界を超えることを示す。

title: Electrical Stark Tuning and In Situ Field Sensing of $V_{2}$ Silicon Vacancies in a 4H-SiC a-Plane Lateral pin-Diode
abstract: Silicon carbide has emerged as a highly promising platform for scalable quantum technologies, with the silicon vacancy serving as a robust spin qubit and quantum sensor. However, conventional c-plane 4H-SiC restricts the experimental scheme and resonant optical excitation to the sample's geometry. The usage of a-plane substrates enables more versatile resonant optical access to the color center through the wafer surface. Here, we demonstrate the electrical control and optical addressability of $V_{2}$ (cubic lattice site) silicon vacancies within the intrinsic region of lateral pin-diodes fabricated on a-plane 4H-SiC wafers using a scalable complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) process. Despite extensive semiconductor processing, the integrated color centers exhibit good optical quality, evidenced by narrow optical transition linewidths below 80 MHz at zero bias. These embedded quantum sensors are utilized for in situ measurement of local electric fields at cryogenic temperatures via the Stark effect. Comparisons with macroscopic technology computer-aided design simulations reveal the value of these integrated quantum sensors to help understand cryogenic device behavior, for example in predicting highly localized field crowding. Furthermore, to address the spectral indistinguishability required for quantum networks, we precisely tune the zero-phonon line (ZPL) of individual emitters via the reverse-bias Stark effect. This successfully compensates for the spectral variations of distinct emitters. Following the relaxation of transient charge fluctuations, the Stark-tuned emitters exhibit spectral stability over measurement periods exceeding four hours. Our results establish a-plane 4H-SiC as a robust platform for future interference experiments and quantum photonic integrated circuits.

summaries.en: The authors demonstrate electrically tunable, optically addressable V2 silicon vacancies embedded in lateral pin-diodes on a-plane 4H-SiC with sub-80 MHz linewidths, using them as in situ cryogenic Stark-effect sensors of local electric fields and to Stark-tune individual zero-phonon lines for spectral indistinguishability with stability beyond four hours.
summaries.zh: 作者在a面4H-SiC上制备的横向pin二极管本征区中展示了可电控、可光学寻址的V2硅空位，其零偏下线宽低于80 MHz，并将其用作低温下基于斯塔克效应的局域电场原位传感器，同时通过反向偏压斯塔克效应调节单个零声子线以实现光谱不可区分性，调谐后稳定性超过四小时。
summaries.ja: 著者らはa面4H-SiC上の横型pinダイオードの真性領域に埋め込んだV2シリコン空孔が80 MHz未満の線幅で電気制御・光学アドレス可能であることを示し、これを低温での局所電場のin situスターク効果センサーとして用いるとともに、逆バイアス印加によるスターク効果で個々のゼロフォノン線を精密に同調させ、4時間以上にわたるスペクトル安定性を達成した。

title: Dynamical Casimir emission from Floquet-driven Landau polaritons: Gauge invariance forbids a superradiant phase transition
abstract: Ultrastrong light--matter coupling of linear systems, such as Landau polaritons formed by a two-dimensional electron gas in a terahertz cavity, is described by the bosonic Hopfield model, and gauge invariance forbids a superradiant phase transition (SRPT). Modulating the magnetic field alone has been predicted to enhance the cycle-averaged coupling and induce a Floquet SRPT. We develop an exact theory of periodically driven Landau polaritons. Including the electric field induced by the modulated flux (Faraday's law), the problem reduces exactly, by Kohn's theorem, to the electronic center-of-mass mode coupled to the cavity, whose Hamiltonian is a sum of squares at every instant. A theorem of Krein then guarantees stability to all orders above a computable drive frequency, the Krein frequency, for which we give a self-contained proof. Below it, the system is stable except within resonance tongues where the drive creates pairs from the vacuum, the dynamical Casimir effect. At high drive frequency the electrons experience the mean field plus a ponderomotive trap (the Fock--Darwin problem), not an enhanced coupling. A gauge theorem excludes a Floquet photon condensate for any band structure, including Kane nonparabolicity, for which we derive a generalized Thomas--Reiche--Kuhn (TRK) sum rule. The predicted transition arises from averaging the coupling in a fixed Landau-level basis, which yields an effective model that violates the TRK sum rule; under driving, gauge invariance also requires the induced Faraday field. The rule to modulate and average the minimal-coupling Hamiltonian, not the parameters of its projection, applies to any linear, minimally coupled system. Instead of an SRPT, magnetic modulation produces dynamical Casimir emission: Faraday-driven polariton--magnetoplasmon pairs at low threshold, and two-color photon pairs with up to 5--10~dB of two-mode squeezing.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)

summaries.en: An exact gauge-invariant theory of periodically driven Landau polaritons shows that magnetic-field modulation cannot induce a Floquet superradiant phase transition but instead produces dynamical Casimir emission, including Faraday-driven polariton–magnetoplasmon pairs and two-color photon pairs with up to 5–10 dB of two-mode squeezing.
summaries.zh: 周期驱动朗道极化激元的精确规范不变理论表明，仅调制磁场不能诱导Floquet超辐射相变，而是产生动力学卡西米尔辐射，包括法拉第驱动的极化激元—磁等离激元对以及具有高达5–10 dB双模压缩的双色光子对。
summaries.ja: 周期的に駆動されたランダウポラリトンの厳密でゲージ不変な理論により、磁場変調だけではフロケ超放射相転移を誘起できず、代わりにファラデー駆動のポラリトン–マグネトプラズモン対や最大5–10 dBの二モードスクイージングを持つ二色光子対を含む動的カシミール放射が生じることが示された。

title: Simulating closed- and open-system dynamics of Tavis--Cummings lattices on fault-tolerant quantum computers
abstract: Tavis--Cummings lattices couple cavities containing several emitters and host polaritonic many-body dynamics whose real-time correlations are costly to compute classically in two dimensions, especially when unequal emitter relaxation or dephasing rates break permutation symmetry. We analyze logical resources for fault-tolerant closed- and open-system simulation of an atom-resolved lattice with $L$ cavities, $N$ emitters per cavity, and photon cutoff $n\_{\max}$, including target observable estimation. Building on ladder-operator block encoding, we construct circuits for photon hopping and local light--matter exchange and combine them to encode the lattice Hamiltonian. By updating source and destination photon occupations in place, the hopping circuit eliminates the auxiliary $L\lceil\log_2(n\_{\max}+1)\rceil$-qubit photon register used by two-register implementations. Across three uniform-coefficient examples with $16$ to $256$ cavities, the controlled walk uses $4.75$--$8.11%$ fewer Toffoli gates than the paired two-register implementation under matched shared preparation, precision, control, and workspace conventions. For closed systems, we implement real-time evolution with generalized quantum signal processing and bound the cost of estimating retarded cavity spectral functions. For open systems with photon loss, emitter relaxation, and dephasing, we use a sampled first-order dilation and bound the runs and timesteps needed to estimate transient photon statistics such as $g^{(2)}(0)$. With state-preparation and measurement costs explicit, these estimates provide a reference for assessing fault-tolerant light--matter lattice simulation costs.

summaries.en: This paper analyzes the fault-tolerant logical resources required to simulate closed- and open-system dynamics of atom-resolved Tavis-Cummings lattices, introducing an in-place photon-hopping circuit that removes an auxiliary photon register and reduces Toffoli counts by 4.
summaries.zh: 本文分析了在容错量子计算机上模拟原子分辨的Tavis-Cummings晶格闭系统和开系统动力学所需的逻辑资源，提出一种就地更新光子占据数的跃迁电路，消除了辅助光子寄存器，并使Toffoli门数量相比双寄存器实现减少4.
summaries.ja: 本論文は、原子分解されたTavis-Cummings格子の閉鎖系および開放系ダイナミクスをフォールトトレラント量子計算機上でシミュレーションするために必要な論理リソースを解析し、光子占有数をその場で更新するホッピング回路により補助光子レジスタを不要にし、二重レジスタ実装と比べてToffoliゲート数を4.
